_comment: basegame's reference macro map -- open country outside Millbrook, proving the engine's outdoor/wilderness room tags (nests/encounters land here in Stage 7). North exit from Overworld Trailhead continues into demo_town.json (the micro map).

rooms.title: Millbrook Wilds - Trailhead - Marker Post
rooms.description: The trail widens into a clearing here, a weathered marker post pointing the way back to town. Wagon ruts fan out toward the fields, the pond, and the treeline.

rooms.title: Millbrook Wilds - Fallow Fields - Furrows
rooms.description: Rows of turned earth run out toward the hills, left to rest for the season. Crows pick at the stubble, scattering whenever the wind gusts.

rooms.title: Millbrook Wilds - Low Hills - Ridge Trail
rooms.description: The ground rises into rocky, sheep-cropped hills, a thin trail switching back along the ridge. From up here the whole valley spreads out below.

rooms.title: Millbrook Wilds - Old Millpond - Shore
rooms.description: Still water sits behind a half-collapsed dam, the old mill's wheel long since seized with rust. Reeds crowd the shallows.

rooms.title: Millbrook Wilds - Forest Edge - Tree Line
rooms.description: The plains give way abruptly to close-grown trees, the light dropping to a cool green shade a few steps in. Birdsong replaces the wind.

rooms.title: Millbrook Wilds - Deep Woods - Thicket
rooms.description: The trees close in tighter here, undergrowth thick enough to slow a careless step. Little sunlight reaches the forest floor.
